rows.sentence: Your neighbor is half right: Sec. 3-5 requires bottle clubs in unincorporated areas to close from midnight Saturday until 7:00 a.m. Monday — you must close at midnight on Saturday.
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The closure rule is stated correctly for unincorporated areas, but the context does not establish that the proposed club will be in one.

rows.sentence: On Sunday there is no midnight closing: you may serve until 2:00 a.m. (Sec. 3-3); the club must be closed 3:00–7:00 a.m.
rows.label: contradictory
rows.rationale: The club is already required to be closed throughout Sunday, so it cannot serve until 2:00 a.m. Monday.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-1: applies to unincorporated county areas and municipalities without their own ordinances; violations are a second-degree misdemeanor.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The section establishes both the geographic scope, with municipal ordinances referring to those covering the regulated subject, and the misdemeanor classification.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-2: a bottle club sells products known to be mixed with alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption.
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The definition does not require a sale or actual mixing. It also covers items dispensed, served, or provided for consideration when they are known or understood to be intended for use in connection with alcohol.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-3 (on-premises): 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily; Sunday 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. next day (golf courses, large banquet halls, hotel guest rooms may start 7:00 a.m. Sunday).
rows.label: unsupported
rows.rationale: The general hours match, but the 7:00 a.m. exceptions require licensed premises, and the banquet-hall exception applies only to qualifying private functions, not to large banquet halls generally.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-4 (off-premises): 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; Sunday 9:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: These are the stated off-premises sales hours, including the later Sunday start.

rows.sentence: Sec. 3-5: bottle clubs closed 3:00–7:00 a.m. daily; closed midnight Saturday to 7:00 a.m. Monday.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: For bottle clubs in the unincorporated areas already identified in the response, the section gives both the regular closure hours and the extended weekend closure.
